Exploration/reshaping of the MMIP study tables (epidemiological data,
chemical exposures, DNA-methylation betas, sample mapping and codebook).
The data are private and are expected in `data/MMIP/` (originally
`G:/My Drive/Dati/MMIP/`).

Source: `met_classification/df_casting.jl`.

```{julia}
using ExposomicsJulia
using DataFrames, Plots
```

```{julia}
df        = read_arrow(datadir("MMIP", "epi.arrow"));
exposure  = read_arrow(datadir("MMIP", "exposure.arrow"));
betas     = read_arrow(datadir("MMIP", "betas.arrow"));
mapping   = read_arrow(datadir("MMIP", "mapping.arrow"));
codebook  = read_arrow(datadir("MMIP", "codebook.arrow"));
```

Short mapping: keep only the oxidative-bisulfite (`OX`) first replicate (all at birth).

```{julia}
mapping = mapping[:, [:Sample_Name, :Methylation_Treatment, :Replicate, :CHILD_PID]]
tmp_mapping = filter([:Methylation_Treatment, :Replicate] => (x, y) -> x == "OX" && y == "rep1", mapping)

betas[:, vcat("rn", tmp_mapping.Sample_Name)]
histogram(Array(betas[1, tmp_mapping.Sample_Name]),
          title = betas[1, "rn"], label = "", bins = 10)
```

Exposure table and chemical groups:

```{julia}
exposure[:, [:CHILD_PID, :Chemical_Group, :Analyte_Code, :Units, :LOD, :Concentration, :Comment_code]]
unique(exposure.Chemical_Group)
```

Restrict to the children with methylation data and cast to wide format
(one column per analyte).

```{julia}
exp_red = filter([:CHILD_PID] => x -> x ∈ tmp_mapping.CHILD_PID, exposure)
dropmissing!(exp_red)
exp_wide = dropmissing(unstack(exp_red, :CHILD_PID, :Analyte_Code, :Concentration))
```

Negative concentrations (below LOD codes):

```{julia}
exposure[exposure.Concentration .< 0, :]
```
